# Change

## Behavior

What changes for a user or maintainer? Link the issue and state acceptance criteria.

## Validation

Commands run and results. For UI changes, attach browser evidence. State what was not verified.

## Workflow changes

For changes to `.github/**`, the `make test-*` commands run locally and their results, plus links to the test runs on
GitHub ([how](TESTING.md)). Otherwise delete this section.

## Data and release impact

Source/provenance changes, generated output, compatibility, and rollback if relevant.
